adjudication.rationale: Verified: the new TRPC input schema allows an unbounded array (`guests: z.array(z.string().email())` in `addGuests.schema.ts`) with no `.max()`, and the handler enforces no upper limit—only filters out existing/blacklisted emails (`uniqueGuests = guests.filter(...)`). It then persists all remaining guests via `createMany` and triggers email sending over the full attendee list (`sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` after `booking.update(...)`), which can scale linearly with the injected guest count (and also increases calendar update work via `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees`). This enables a single authenticated call to create a very large number of attendees and cause large outbound email fan-out/resource exhaustion.
